name: Sheshan
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Sheshan was a man from the tribe of Judah who had no sons, only daughters. He gave his daughter to his Egyptian servant Jarha as a wife, and through this connection the family line continued. He is mentioned in the genealogies of Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Sheshan's Family Line
keyEvents.description: Sheshan is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah as a descendant of Jerahmeel. He had no sons, but he had daughters.

keyEvents.title: Sheshan's Daughters
keyEvents.description: It is told that Sheshan had no sons, only daughters. This was an important detail for the line of inheritance in Israel.

keyEvents.title: Sheshan's Egyptian Servant Jarha
keyEvents.description: Sheshan had an Egyptian servant named Jarha, to whom he gave his daughter as a wife so that the family line would continue.

keyEvents.title: Attai is Born
keyEvents.description: Sheshan's daughter and Jarha had a son named Attai, who carried on the family line. This shows that foreigners could be incorporated into Israel's lineage.

keyEvents.title: The Lineage After Sheshan
keyEvents.description: Through Attai, Sheshan's lineage continued for many generations, all the way to important figures in the tribe of Judah.
